"2026-05-27" caption_note = "data via WarrenNolan.com | Table by Chris at Bless your chart" # Standard Sage Green Theme color_positive <- "#EAEFEA" color_dominant <- "#A1C9A8" color_negative <- "#FFE7E7" color_dominant_neg <- "#FF9999" color_zero <- "#F5F5F5" bracket_teams <- tibble::tribble( ~team_name, ~espn_id, ~side, "Troy", 2653, "Side 1", "West Virginia", 277, "Side 1", "North Carolina", 153, "Side 1", "Ole Miss", 145, "Side 1", "Oklahoma", 201, "Side 2", "Alabama", 333, "Side 2", "Texas", 251, "Side 2", "Georgia", 61, "Side 2" ) scrape_team_schedule <- function(team_name, season) { url_slug <- stringr::str_replace_all(team_name, " ", "-") url <- paste0("https://www.warrennolan.com/baseball/", season, "/schedule/", url_slug) page <- rvest::read_html(url) game_blocks <- page |> rvest::html_elements("li.team-schedule") parse_game <- function(block, game_id) { month <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__game-date--month") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) day <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__game-date--day") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) date <- as.Date(paste0(month, " ", day, " ", season), format = "%b %d %Y") loc_text <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__location") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) game_location <- dplyr::case_when( stringr::str_detect(loc_text, "AT") ~ "Away", stringr::str_detect(loc_text, "VS") ~ "Neutral", TRUE ~ "Home" ) opponent <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__opp-line-link") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) box_table <- block |> rvest::html_element("table.team-schedule-bottom__box-score") if (is.na(box_table)) return(NULL) box_rows <- box_table |> rvest::html_elements("tr") if (length(box_rows) < 3) return(NULL) parse_row <- function(row) { team <- row |> rvest::html_elements("td") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) |> dplyr::first() team_clean <- stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_remove(team, "\\s*\\(\\d+\\)")) inning_vals <- row |> rvest::html_elements("td.team-schedule-bottom__box-score:not(.team-schedule-bottom__box-score--totals)") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) inning_vals <- inning_vals[-1] totals <- row |> rvest::html_elements("td.team-schedule-bottom__box-score--totals") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) list(team = team_clean, innings = inning_vals, totals = totals) } row2 <- parse_row(box_rows[[2]]) row3 <- parse_row(box_rows[[3]]) if (is.null(row2) || is.null(row3)) return(NULL) is_target_row2 <- (tolower(row2$team) == tolower(team_name)) is_target_row3 <- (tolower(row3$team) == tolower(team_name)) if (!is_target_row2 && !is_target_row3) return(NULL) target_row <- if (is_target_row2) row2 else row3 opp_row <- if (is_target_row2) row3 else row2 team_total <- if (is_target_row2) { suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row2$totals[1])) } else { suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row3$totals[1])) } opp_total <- if (is_target_row2) { suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row3$totals[1])) } else { suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row2$totals[1])) } if (is.na(team_total) || is.na(opp_total) || (team_total == 0 && opp_total == 0)) return(NULL) n_innings <- max(length(target_row$innings), length(opp_row$innings)) if (n_innings == 0) return(NULL) innings_df <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_innings), function(i) { target_val <- if (i <= length(target_row$innings)) target_row$innings[i] else NA_character_ opp_val <- if (i <= length(opp_row$innings)) opp_row$innings[i] else NA_character_ clean <- function(v) { if (is.na(v) || v == "X" || v == "") NA_real_ else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)) } target_runs <- clean(target_val) opp_runs <- clean(opp_val) both_na <- is.na(target_runs) & is.na(opp_runs) tibble::tibble( inning = i, team_runs = target_runs, opp_runs = opp_runs, inning_diff = dplyr::if_else(!both_na, dplyr::coalesce(target_runs, 0) - dplyr::coalesce(opp_runs, 0), NA_real_), score_inn = dplyr::if_else(!both_na, paste0(dplyr::coalesce(target_val, "x"), "-", dplyr::coalesce(opp_val, "x")), NA_character_) ) }) innings_df |> dplyr::mutate( game_id = game_id, date = date, game_location = game_location, opponent = opponent, team_total = team_total, opp_total = opp_total, diff_total = team_total - opp_total, score_total = paste0(team_total, "-", opp_total) ) } purrr::imap(as.list(game_blocks), \(block, idx) purrr::possibly(parse_game, NULL)(block, idx)) |> purrr::compact() |> dplyr::bind_rows() } build_innings_wide <- function(innings_long, date_cutoff, team_name, team_max_innings) { innings_long_filtered <- innings_long |> dplyr::filter(date >= as.Date(date_cutoff)) if (nrow(innings_long_filtered) == 0) return(NULL) innings_wide_filtered <- innings_long_filtered |>
